short: Geiseric seized Carthage by surprise, ending the truce and cutting off the grain that fed Rome and Italy.
full:
On 19 October 439 CE, the Vandal king Geiseric broke a peace treaty agreed only three years earlier and seized Carthage, the western empire's third-largest city, by surprise while its garrison was unprepared. The city became the capital of an independent Vandal kingdom that controlled the richest grain-producing province in the western Mediterranean.

The loss was catastrophic for Rome and Italy, which depended on African grain shipments to feed their populations; the western government spent much of the next generation trying, and repeatedly failing, to recover the province by force. Geiseric also built a fleet from Carthage's harbour that raided Sicily, Sardinia and eventually Italy itself, making the Vandal kingdom the dominant naval power in the western Mediterranean for decades.
